title: From Hype to Habit: How We’re Building an AI-First SaaS Company—While Still Shipping the Roadmap
talk_summary: A Sprout Social product/strategy talk about organizational AI transformation across strategy, ways of working, and people, with no engineering mechanisms, benchmarks, or agent-system details.

takeaways.what_they_do: They evaluate each process against outcomes (clarity, unblocking, faster decisions) and iterate or cut it if it fails those tests, rather than accumulating process.
takeaways.evidence_quote: we've started treating process as a product. We evaluate it against outcomes.

takeaways.what_they_do: They build explicit time into planning cycles for experiments and hackathons, making discovery a repeatable visible process instead of ad hoc spikes.
takeaways.evidence_quote: we need to treat discovery as repeatable deliberate process. And that's what ritualized discovery means.

takeaways.technique: Internal self-service platform for AI prototyping
takeaways.what_they_do: They plan a self-service platform so product and engineering teams can prototype and ship AI features without deep involvement from the central AI team.
takeaways.evidence_quote: we aim to build souls service platform to enable product and engineering teams across the organization to prototype and ship AI powered features

takeaways.what_they_do: They invest in people with deep expertise who can also prototype quickly and work across silos end-to-end.
takeaways.evidence_quote: we are investing in T-shaped talent. People with deep expertise who can also stretch wide, prototype quickly
